name: io.github.ToCSharp/PaspanCodeGraphMcp
description: Read-only C# and C++ code graph for AI agents: references, call graph, hierarchy and GraphRAG retrieval, without Roslyn, clang or MSBuild.

environmentVariables.name: PASPAN_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: The .sln, .slnx, .csproj, .vcxproj, compile_commands.json or directory (also of C++ sources) to load at startup; without it, the agent calls workspace_load.

environmentVariables.name: PASPAN_CONFIGURATION
environmentVariables.description: The build configuration that project conditions and DEBUG/RELEASE depend on (default Debug).

environmentVariables.name: PASPAN_WATCH
environmentVariables.description: 0 to stop watching the files for changes.

environmentVariables.name: PASPAN_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: 0 to stop keeping the graph in .paspan/graph.bin next to the solution.
